name: AE Employer Election — Pace Thermometer
description: Quick visual check on how far along Employer Annual Enrollment is: actual completion rate vs. the expected pace for this point in the cycle. Prototype (2026-10-01), leadership requested a 'Thermometer/Barometer for expectations' for both Member and Employer reporting -- this is the Employer half, stylistically paired with sac-member-pace-widget.

feeds.description: Same employerStatus binding as sac-ae-snap-report-widget/sac-ae-operational-widget -- AM_EMPLOYER_ENROLLMENT_SUMMARY, dimensions in order: Status / Synod-Region / Election Sub-Type / Date / Year. This widget only reads the Status/Region row-kind -- rows where Election Sub-Type (dimensions_2) is blank and Status (dimensions_0) is non-blank.
Employer Count, Employee Count -- same order as the sibling widgets. This widget only reads Employer Count (measures_0).

refresh.description: Re-renders the gauge from the currently bound data
